column1: # Retrieval evaluation set.
# One query per line: the words a reader would actually type, a tab, then the card
# ids that would be a good answer. Any one of them counts as correct, because
# several cards can legitimately answer the same question and forcing a single
# right answer measures the fixture rather than the search.
# These are written as they type: lowercase, conversational, occasionally
# misspelled. A query set of tidy keywords would score beautifully and tell us
# nothing, since keyword search is the case that already works.
# Run:  cargo run --bin evaluate
# The numbers exist to answer one question: does adding semantic search beat
# lexical alone? Measure before, measure after, keep it only if it wins.
